定量评估、软硬件协同设计 与 Patterson 共同建立系统、定量的架构设计方法，使 RISC 和软硬件协同成为可验证的设计路线。
简化接口、系统组合与开放架构 与 Hennessy 共同建立系统、定量的架构设计方法，使 RISC 和软硬件协同成为可验证的设计路线。
整体性能与并行边界 推动流水线、指令前瞻与缓存创新，并揭示整体性能受不可并行工作限制。
处理器分类、算术与并行组织 建立按指令流与数据流理解计算机组织的框架，使并行结构与资源利用可以系统比较。
流水线、性能模型与应用评估 将高性能流水线与多处理器的设计、调度和性能评估连接起来，使资源占用可被系统分析。
语言导向架构与程序层次 以程序语言的结构指导计算机设计，用栈和自动过程链接缩小高级语言与机器执行之间的距离。
微程序与可构造的控制 建成 EDSAC 并推动程序库实践，又以微程序把指令控制转成可系统设计的操作序列。
计算机类别、系统组织与经济边界 把高性能计算机从设计带到可用产品，并以价格、软件环境与接口共同解释计算机类别的演化。
计算机家族、接口与概念一致性 推动计算机体系结构与具体实现分离，并把兼容的计算机家族落实为 IBM System/360 的设计主线。
交互式计算与任务现场 与团队创造 LINC，把可交互的计算、采样与实验控制带到研究者自己的实验台。
交互式计算、网络与完整系统 设计并实现 Xerox Alto，把图形交互、本地计算与网络服务整合为可工作的个人计算系统。
兼容架构与处理器演进 推动 x86 从既有软件基础扩展为 32 位平台，让地址能力与指令表达的改进保持可迁移性。
抽象、模块化与可实现的复杂系统 以可重构、可验证的设计组织推进复杂芯片，并共同提出用寄存器映射消除数据搬运的具体机制。
ISA、实现与软件层边界 通过指令实现与编译软件协同，重新划分软件接口和处理器内部复杂性。
技术演进、架构生态与协作 将低能耗研究与处理器 IP 的可交付流程衔接，显式管理时序裕量和验证成本。
ISA 演进、系统契约与安全验证 以 Morello 能力指针和 CCA Realm 两条路线，推动 Arm 分别限制内存访问权限与云端软件信任范围。
开放接口与可演进实现 与团队建立开放、可扩展的 RISC-V 指令集，把软件契约与不同实现的实验空间分开。
ISA 简洁性与编码取舍 通过 RISC-V 规范与博士论文，把简洁、模块化的 ISA 设计变成可检验的代码密度与实现取舍。
指令语义与可实现性 与 Steve Furber 共同创造 BBC Micro 和早期 ARM 架构，把精简处理器做成可负担的完整系统。
长期 ISA 契约与性能诊断 共同设计面向长期扩展的 Alpha AXP，把 64 位、并行实现与软件迁移纳入同一架构契约。
接口、提示与故障边界 推动分布式个人计算，并把真实系统经验提炼为兼顾接口、性能与恢复能力的设计原则。
紧凑编码与嵌入式 ISA 设计 Thumb 紧凑指令及 ARM/Thumb 切换，使较窄取指接口仍可驱动 32 位数据通路。
从软件需求定义 ISA 从软件表达和迁移需求定义 8086 架构，再与逻辑设计协商实现成本。
软件与器件规范的协商 参与细化 8086 的软件可见架构，把指令、地址组织和软件支持放在同一迁移约束下。
开放 ISA 的可组合规范 参与 RISC-V 中断规范并阐释 chiplet 平台分区，将软件契约与系统扩展一同约束。
兼容式 ISA 扩展 共同设计兼容式 x86-64 扩展，并将寄存器、地址空间和多处理器内存通路纳入 Opteron 的整体架构。
ISA 演进与兼容边界 共同发展兼容式 x86-64 和事务同步扩展，把 ISA 机制与软件迁移、失败回退一起设计。
机器接口与实现解耦 共同构建 System/38 的硬件与微码控制基础，并以技术独立接口延续 AS/400 应用投资。
交互表示与约束系统 以 Sketchpad 把图形从计算结果变成可直接编辑、复用并受约束的设计对象。
计算媒介与消息抽象 开创面向对象与个人计算的重要理念，并领导 Smalltalk 团队把消息交互变成可工作的编程环境。
增强人的集体问题解决 提出增强人的问题解决能力的系统愿景，并与团队以 NLS 将交互编辑、结构化信息和协作工具付诸实现。
SIMD 与 ISA 扩展 共同发展 AltiVec，以独立向量寄存器和灵活重排支持媒体数据并行。
硬件与系统软件的协同演进 参与 CAP 系统软件并合著 Cambridge 分布式系统，将保护、共享和实现分工放在完整系统中解释。
数据规模、I/O 与基础设施约束 把大数据界定为相对系统能力的工作负载边界，分析容量增长与 I/O 服务速度不匹配。
Scoreboard 与执行资源协调 以 CDC 6600 的记分牌协调多个功能单元，使单一指令流中的独立操作能够重叠执行。
动态调度与名字依赖 以保留站、标签和公共数据总线实现动态指令调度，让独立运算越过等待而保持真实数据依赖。
动态执行、推测与数据流 推动指令级并行与超标量设计，以有限活动窗口中的数据流执行提高单线程效率。
预测、精确状态与解耦执行 推动分支预测与可恢复高性能执行；用有限历史状态提升预测可靠性，而非盲目追求更大预测表。
动态执行、存储依赖与推测 把乱序执行、顺序提交与推测恢复结合起来，推动高性能处理器在保持程序语义时提取更多并行。
分支预测、历史组织与缓存映射 以 TAGE 分支预测和缓存组织创新，提高处理器对控制流与数据访问的有效利用。
SMT、动态资源共享与线程互补 以 SMT 和多处理器共享研究，让独立线程动态利用单线程无法占满的执行资源。
微架构建模与性能归因 用可测量的性能归因连接处理器模型与真实实现，使微架构优化有据可查。
乱序执行与访存并行 将单线程的访存并行度明确列为优化目标，并共同披露支持多个未完成缺失的非阻塞缓存机制。
处理器组织、多媒体与非对称计算 推动高性能与多媒体处理器，并把异构计算的资源分配从局部加速转向整体最优。
工业微架构与可交付的设计 领导把高性能乱序微架构落实到 x86 产品，并以真实代码的依赖分析检验 RISC/CISC 争论。
工业 CPU 微架构与跨代 PPA 领导 Zen 核心架构设计，以前端、执行与缓存的协同改进兼顾单线程性能、吞吐和能效。
寄存器映射与数据搬运消除 共同提出用寄存器映射复用消除可预测的数据搬运，并以验证和恢复维持正确性。
SoC 带宽与内存功率反馈 共同发展 SoC 带宽反馈和内存性能状态控制，将数据供给与功耗动态协调。
异构执行与迁移边界 领导 big.LITTLE 与 Cortex-A53 开发，让不同能效的兼容核心按任务需求协同工作。
产品路线、PPA 与跨代交付 以异构共享与模块化分区组织处理器平台演进，协调计算、I/O、工艺和功率约束。

entries.t: Hot Chips 2017 · Programmability leaves isolation work.
entries.x: P4 described trusted program control but deferred concurrent independent-program virtualization. Vega's guest ownership mechanism did not supply switching-latency figures. A programming interface alone did not establish predictable tenant sharing. T1 128:59 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2017 · Locality shapes useful throughput.
entries.x: Volta's tensor reduction depended on the kernel/framework and intermediate placement. Cisco's serial-attached memory traded capacity and connectivity against higher latency and I/O power. Peak arithmetic and link bandwidth hid different costs. S1 95:08 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2017 · Packaging needs economic and test evidence.
entries.x: EMIB questions probed access, cost and known-good-die assurance. EPYC's organic package prompted performance and die-yield questions. Integration feasibility did not settle supplier access, usable yield or the complete platform tradeoff. S5 62:41 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2017 · Formats and software constrain specialization.
entries.x: Brainwave questions pressed precision and accuracy assumptions. TPU exchanges examined workload size, sparsity and framework selection. AWS F1 required manual partitioning across FPGAs. Hardware specialization still demanded model and application work. S5 117:55 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2017 · Timing figures need complete paths.
entries.x: Arm defined L2 timing from address generation through the access path; system atomic details remained incomplete. EPYC's encryption answer discussed latency against coherence behavior. A cycle count or coherent address did not specify the whole transaction. S8 57:57 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2018 · Security needs an explicit contract.
entries.x: The Spectre/Meltdown panel discussed protected execution subcontexts and shared accelerator state. Cascade Lake supplied no verification evidence for mitigation coverage. Titan narrowed the trusted surface without removing every CPU, software or foundry dependency. K1 88:26 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2018 · Programmability shifts work into mapping.
entries.x: Project Everest disclosed no autovectorizing compiler and deferred receive-programming details. Pixel Visual Core and dynamic-graph questions tested what developers still had to map and synchronize. Higher-level access did not prove transparent application portability. S5 90:37 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2018 · Memory needs lifecycle accounting.
entries.x: Mythic's intermediate activations occupied tile SRAM; A64FX had an HBM capacity ceiling. Optane answers withheld requested endurance and operating-state power figures. Density and bandwidth alone did not establish service lifetime or working-set fit. S9 123:48 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2018 · Sparsity benefits differ by mechanism.
entries.x: Arm said 3D convolution could be mapped without native support; DeePhi used structured sparsity. Mythic said zero weights would reduce current without increasing dense-matrix capacity. Energy, compute and capacity benefits required workload-specific evidence. S6 64:46 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2018 · Efficiency claims need matching boundaries.
entries.x: Samsung's power comparison was not fully process-normalized. XDNN described mapped compute rather than all FPGA resources. NRAM cell energy and Mythic whole-chip energy covered different budgets; their ratios could not be compared directly. S1 38:28 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2019 · Interconnect names leave mechanisms unresolved.
entries.x: Arm's cache stashing needed software and interface prerequisites; Xilinx qualified its nonblocking-mesh claim through traffic-class isolation. AWS discussed placement groups and packet-aware limiting. Topology and peak link rate did not describe congestion behavior. S1 66:07 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2019 · Peak compute needs workload evidence.
entries.x: Huawei and Spring Crest faced benchmark and MLPerf questions. Cerebras deferred working-system performance. Microsoft's compression comparison used different algorithms. Those answers exposed comparison boundaries that peak throughput alone could not resolve. S4 30:23 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2019 · Sparse workloads make placement decisive.
entries.x: Facebook described profile-guided embedding partitioning, local bandwidth versus distributed latency, and prefetch overfetch. UPMEM DPUs communicated through the CPU. Irregular accesses and host work belonged in accelerator sizing alongside dense kernels. S2 25:52 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2019 · Numerical formats carry software obligations.
entries.x: Intel linked its Flexpoint-to-BF16 change to software scaling. Google's BF16 and array-size answers described tested models and compiler co-design. Datatype support alone did not establish convergence, rounding behavior or utilization on real tensor shapes. S4 61:07 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2019 · Integration adds power, test and trust gates.
entries.x: Lakefield described known-good-die testing but left stacking limits unquantified. Tesla's dual-SoC safety intent did not specify disagreement handling. Jintide's monitor answer did not establish a complete host trust boundary. S8 26:47 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2020 · Memory choice follows workload and economics.
entries.x: Pensando justified HBM-to-DDR migration through capacity flexibility, buffering and cost. Tenstorrent distinguished inference LPDDR4 from training GDDR6. Xbox balanced GPU bandwidth with CPU latency. No single memory hierarchy won every workload. S6 59:20 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2020 · Useful scale includes failed links.
entries.x: Tofino telemetry distinguished local timing from WAN synchronization. Fungible emphasized connectivity; TPU Pod recovery details remained incomplete. Cerebras described redundant cores and routes. Nominal line rate did not establish degraded-mode behavior. T1 106:31 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2020 · Placement and compilation remain deployment work.
entries.x: Versal relocation depended on repeated fabric patterns. Tenstorrent claimed dynamic-graph support; Cerebras described typical compilation in minutes. These answers did not establish general operator coverage, difficult-model compile tails or effortless placement changes. S5 61:58 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2020 · Security and lifetime need operating evidence.
entries.x: Ice Lake encryption overhead came from unspecified preproduction experiments; Tiger Lake withheld latency figures. Lightmatter discussed manufacturing precedents without quantitative array lifetime evidence. Targets and precedent left qualification gaps. S1 45:43 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2020 · Benchmarks need full pipeline boundaries.
entries.x: DeepMind treated MLPerf as useful but insufficient for evolving research. Lightmatter separated simulator results and analog timing from measured digital performance. Conversion, transfers, host work and workload diversity remained essential comparison terms. K2 56:27 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2021 · Feed the accelerator before judging arithmetic.
entries.x: Samsung attributed the gap between PIM bandwidth uplift and application speedup to unchanged host and ordering overheads. Facebook emphasized ingestion benchmarking and reuse. Translation, DRAM-bank behavior and preprocessing still limited useful throughput. S4 88:51 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2021 · The software path is part of the architecture.
entries.x: Skydio described expensive architecture-specific optimization during porting. Alder Lake Linux-support questions survived without recoverable answers. Facebook's merged reads were client software. An engine or instruction did not establish a ready application path. K2 47:07 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2021 · Transport and ordering define integration.
entries.x: IBM described scoped ordering around Telum's accelerator; Enflame used noncoherent copies and mailboxes. Mount Evans' transport details were deferred. Compatibility, coherence and reliable transport were distinct properties requiring separate evidence. S1 97:29 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2021 · Precision needs replay and quality evidence.
entries.x: Graphcore described controlled seeds for stochastic-rounding replay. Xilinx distinguished BF16 from block floating point; Anton selected formats by pipeline stage. Efficiency depended on numerical behavior and workload quality rather than the format name alone. S6 29:24 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2021 · Density and power need separate proof.
entries.x: Intel discussed PowerVia with stacking and EMIB's yield/reach tradeoffs. Anton justified a global clock mesh through latency and power. TSMC cooling questions lacked useful caption answers; package scalability did not establish facility feasibility. T2.1 52:49 ↗

entries.t: Hot Chips 2022 · Bandwidth boundaries reach the software model
entries.x: AMD explained MI250X’s two-device exposure through inter-die bandwidth relative to HBM. Intel confirmed coherent cross-stack access on Ponte Vecchio while warning of NUMA effects and offering a two-sub-device configuration. Coherence does not remove placement-sensitive performance.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2022 · Software readiness changes the value of hardware
entries.x: NVIDIA described Transformer Engine as hardware plus software; AMD described framework integration as ongoing. Intel separated demonstrated throughput from a newer specification calculation, and Biren distinguished standard benchmark settings from customer-specific models. Evaluation needs the exact software release, workload and measurement basis.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2022 · Scale depends on mapping and coordination
entries.x: NVIDIA described Ethernet or InfiniBand beyond the 256-GPU NVLink domain and the need to map work to bandwidth boundaries. Cerebras placed static-route planning and deadlock avoidance in software. CXL discussion identified directory growth and invalidation traffic as coherence scaling costs.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2022 · Dynamic workloads test static designs
entries.x: Groq’s answers addressed predication, resident-code dispatch and nondeterministic I/O. Tesla explained that its memory ratio is configurable and that LLMs would likely need more DRAM around a tile. Workload balance must be tested rather than inferred from topology.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2022 · Access latency and resilience require complete paths
entries.x: Grace Q&A emphasized translation throughput while declining a remote-memory latency figure. Tesla discussed ECC, retries, redundancy and limited rerouting; Juniper connected retransmission to residual errors across many links and challenged inconsistent power-reporting conditions. Test translation, remote access, degraded-mode throughput and recovery together.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2023 · Software compatibility is part of the architecture.
entries.x: ROCm coverage, vector support and compiler responsibility drew questions across vendors. A hardware feature did not establish a usable software path.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2023 · Claims were tested against real workloads.
entries.x: Questions asked what had been built and measured. Intel distinguished physical graph-compute testbeds from larger modeled configurations.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2023 · Packaging raised integration questions.
entries.x: Chiplet arrangement, verification, materials and assembly all drew scrutiny. Physical integration answers were more concrete than future interoperability plans.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2023 · Cooling scrutiny included operational maturity.
entries.x: Google described favorable operating experience. Fabric8 Labs said lifetime testing remained outstanding, despite promising thermal results.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2023 · Precision gains depended on model fit.
entries.x: Questions tested sparsity structure, format choice and accuracy. Tutorial answers emphasized sensitivity and workload dependence.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2024 · Memory placement and coherence drew sustained probing.
entries.x: AMD confirmed directed probes but left protocol details unresolved. Questions also tested HBM access efficiency, PIM interfaces and memory overhead.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2024 · Runtime flexibility needed practical detail.
entries.x: Questions examined partitioning, debugging, context switching and concurrent models. Some configuration features were explained while their overhead remained unquantified.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2024 · Sparse gains needed full cost accounting.
entries.x: Onyx questions exposed conversion and metadata costs. Meta separated evaluated or analytical benefits from deployed improvements.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2024 · Cooling was examined at system level.
entries.x: Questions covered rack limits, maintenance, capex and prototype evidence. Chip heat removal alone did not settle the facility decision.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2024 · Optical integration still needed qualification.
entries.x: Intel called OCI a technology demonstration. Laser history from pluggable modules did not establish reliability in the proposed CPU package.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2025 · Fabric mechanisms mattered beyond bandwidth.
entries.x: Questions probed retries, buffers, programmable controls and mixed-vendor operation. Interoperability did not establish equal performance.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2025 · Optics exposed packaging and repair tradeoffs.
entries.x: Thermal paths, fiber connections and driver placement drew scrutiny. External laser replacement left internal optical-engine repair unresolved.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2025 · Metric boundaries changed the interpretation.
entries.x: Marvell excluded DRAM latency from its expander figure. dMatrix reported a core efficiency metric; NVIDIA clarified the traffic used in its noise test.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2025 · Memory expansion needed an access model.
entries.x: Questions tested host paths, capacity and coherence. Marvell scoped coherence to the expander; IBM discussed added memory-path latency and capacity tradeoffs.

entries.t: Hot Chips 2025 · Reliability required system-level recovery.
entries.x: Stacked-memory mitigations lacked field failure statistics. Huawei’s recovery depended on checkpoints and spare racks, not just a redundant chip.
Participants challenged precision, workloads and measurement boundaries, not just headline speedups.
Routing, shared bandwidth and recovery mattered alongside aggregate link rates.
Capacity questions also probed spill, migration and KV placement costs.
Framework support did not settle porting effort or placement control.
Protocol names left ownership and data-return paths unresolved.
Threading rationales still needed workload-specific isolation and utilization comparisons.

entries.t: P01 · US CHIPS and Science Act signed / 美国《芯片与科学法案》签署

entries.t: P02 · BIS advanced-computing and semiconductor-manufacturing export controls / BIS 发布先进计算与半导体制造出口管制
entries.x: 2022-10-07 Restricts the PRC's ability to buy and make certain high-end chips: advanced-computing and supercomputer end-use controls plus controls on some chipmaking items, effective in phases (Oct 7, Oct 12, Oct 21, 2022). 限制中国购买和制造部分高端芯片：先进计算与超算最终用途管制，以及部分半导体制造设备管制；分阶段生效（10月7日、10月12日、10月21日）。

entries.t: P03 · Netherlands and Japan add chipmaking-equipment controls / 荷兰、日本跟进半导体设备出口管制
entries.x: 2023-03-08 After a January 2023 US–Dutch–Japanese understanding, the Netherlands required licences for the most advanced DUV immersion tools and Japan controlled 23 equipment types. 2023年1月美、荷、日达成谅解后，荷兰对最先进DUV浸没式光刻设备要求许可，日本对23类设备实施管制。

entries.t: P04 · China adds export licensing for gallium and germanium / 中国对镓、锗实施出口许可
entries.x: 2023-08-01 MOFCOM introduced export licensing for gallium and germanium items, widely read as a response to the Oct 2022–Jul 2023 controls; a Dec 2024 directive tightened exports to the US. 商务部对镓、锗相关物项实施出口许可，被广泛视为对2022年10月至2023年7月期间一系列管制的回应；2024年12月进一步限制对美出口。

entries.t: P05 · BIS updates advanced-computing and equipment controls / BIS 更新先进计算与设备管制
entries.x: 2023-10-17 Two interim final rules expand and tighten the October 2022 controls (advanced-computing items, supercomputer and semiconductor end uses, semiconductor manufacturing items). 两项临时最终规则扩展并收紧2022年10月管制（先进计算物项、超算与半导体最终用途、半导体制造物项）。

entries.t: P06 · BIS adds HBM, equipment and Entity List controls / BIS 对 HBM、设备与实体清单加严
entries.x: 2024-12-02 An interim final rule controls high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and adds 24 types of manufacturing equipment and 3 software-tool types; about 140 Entity List additions came the same day. 临时最终规则将高带宽内存（HBM）纳入管制并新增24类制造设备与3类软件工具管制；同时新增约140家实体清单实体。

entries.t: P07 · China adds export licensing on seven rare-earth elements and magnets / 中国对七种中重稀土及磁体实施出口许可
entries.x: 2025-04-04 From 4 Apr 2025, exports of seven medium and heavy rare-earth elements and related magnets require licences; later scope changes and suspensions are described inconsistently. 2025年4月4日起，七种中重稀土元素及相关磁体出口需许可；后续范围与暂停安排来源说法不一。

Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries “for the indefinite future”; NVIDIA expected up to about $5.5B of charges in the quarter. Some licences for certain China customers followed from Aug 2025 (per later 8-Ks). 美国政府要求向中国（含香港、澳门）及 D:5 国家出口 H20 需许可，且“在可预见的将来”持续；NVIDIA 预计一季度最多约55亿美元相关费用。2025年8月起部分获准向特定中国客户出货（据其后续 8-K）。

entries.x: 2025-05-13 Rescinds the AI Diffusion Rule (issued 15 Jan 2025, due to bind from 15 May); promises a replacement rule and issues three guidance documents on Huawei Ascend chips, AI-model training end uses and diversion risks. 撤销2025年1月15日发布、原定5月15日生效的AI扩散规则；承诺将来发布替代规则，并就华为昇腾芯片、AI模型训练最终用途与供应链转运风险发布三份指引。

entries.x: 2025-09-15 China's SAMR announced a preliminary finding that NVIDIA breached conditions attached to its 2020 Mellanox acquisition; the probe continued and NVIDIA said it complies with the law. 市场监管总局宣布初步调查认为 NVIDIA 违反2020年 Mellanox 收购的附加条件；调查继续，NVIDIA 称遵守法律并将配合。

2025-04-08 Low-latency, high-bandwidth interconnect between accelerators and switches in an AI pod: 200G per lane, up to 1,024 accelerators per pod, with a load/store protocol using read, write and atomic transactions. 面向AI算力池内加速器与交换机的低延迟、高带宽互连：200G每通道，单个计算池最多1,024个加速器；提供读、写与原子事务的加载/存储协议。

entries.t: S02 · Ultra Ethernet Specification 1.0 (Ultra Ethernet Consortium (UEC))
entries.x: 2025-06-11 An Ethernet-based communication stack spanning NICs, switches, optics and cables; brings modern RDMA to Ethernet and IP, and stresses end-to-end scaling to millions of endpoints and multi-vendor interoperability. 以以太网为基础的通信栈，覆盖网卡、交换机、光模块与线缆等各层；把现代RDMA带到以太网与IP，并强调到百万级端点的端到端扩展与多厂商互操作。

2025-08-05 Open chiplet interconnect standard: data rates rise to 48 and 64 GT/s (2.0 was 32 GT/s) for 2D (UCIe-S) and 2.5D (UCIe-A) packaging; fully backward compatible; sideband reach extends to 100 mm, with firmware management and emergency controls for multi-chip SiPs. 开放芯粒互连标准：数据速率提升至48与64 GT/s（2.0为32 GT/s），适用于2D（UCIe-S）与2.5D（UCIe-A）封装；完全向后兼容；侧带距离扩展到100 mm，并增加多芯片SiP的固件管理与紧急控制。

2024-12-03 Open coherent interconnect: adds a Hot-Page Monitoring Unit (CHMU) for memory tiering, common event records, online firmware activation and extends security through the Trusted Security Protocol (TSP); fully backward compatible with all earlier CXL specifications. 开放的一致性互连：新增用于内存分层的热页监测单元（CHMU）、通用事件记录、在线固件激活，并通过可信安全协议（TSP）扩展安全；与此前所有CXL规范完全向后兼容。

2025-04-16 2048-bit interface, up to 8 Gb/s per pin, up to about 2 TB/s per stack; independent channels double from 16 to 32 (two pseudo-channels each); 4- to 16-high stacks of 24 Gb or 32 Gb dies; the interface keeps backward compatibility with HBM3 controllers. 2048位接口，引脚速率最高8 Gb/s，单堆栈最高约2 TB/s；独立通道由16个增至32个（各含2个伪通道）；堆叠4–16层，裸片24 Gb或32 Gb；接口定义保持与HBM3控制器的向后兼容。

2025-06-11 128 GT/s raw rate per lane, up to about 512 GB/s bidirectional at x16; PAM4 signalling with flit encoding; backward compatible; an Optical Aware Retimer ECN is separate. The PCI-SIG roadmap mentions 8.0 (256 GT/s) planned by 2028. 128 GT/s每通道原始速率，x16双向最高约512 GB/s；采用PAM4与flit编码；保持向后兼容；另有光学感知重定时器ECN。PCI-SIG路线图提到8.0（256 GT/s）计划于2028年前发布。

Broadcom's SUE contribution evolved into the SUE-T workstream (per search resu

2025-05-18 A programme that lets partners build semi-custom AI infrastructure around NVLink; first adopters named include MediaTek, Marvell, Alchip, Astera Labs, Synopsys and Cadence; Fujitsu and Qualcomm said they plan to pair custom CPUs with NVIDIA GPUs. 让合作伙伴围绕NVLink构建半定制AI基础设施的方案；首批采用者包括联发科、Marvell、Alchip、Astera Labs、Synopsys与Cadence；富士通与高通表示计划把自研CPU与NVIDIA GPU配对。
2.5D places dies side by side on an interposer; 3D stacks dies vertically. 2.5D把多个裸片并排放在中介层上；3D把裸片垂直堆叠。
A chip customised for a specific job; cloud providers' in-house AI chips are usually ASICs. 为特定任务定制的芯片；云厂商自研AI芯片常属此类。
Average selling price per unit; revenue growth should be split into volume and ASP. 单位产品的平均销售价格；收入增长要拆成数量与ASP两部分看。
The bottom die of an HBM stack; it carries the interface to the processor and some logic, and custom HBM variants can change this layer. HBM堆叠最底层的裸片，承载与处理器的接口和部分逻辑；定制HBM变体可以改写这一层。

entries.t: BF16 / FP8 / FP4 / BF16 / FP8 / FP4
entries.x: Low-precision number formats that trade accuracy for throughput and memory; models and software must keep quality acceptable. 低精度数值格式：用更少的位表示数值，以换取吞吐与内存，但需要模型与软件配合保证精度。

entries.t: BIS / 美国商务部工业与安全局
entries.x: The US Commerce Department bureau responsible for export controls. 美国商务部下负责出口管制的机构。
Protocol that keeps copies of the same data consistent across caches; coherence does not remove placement sensitivity. 保证多个缓存中同一数据副本保持一致的协议；一致性不等于消除放置敏感性。
Spending on long-lived assets such as fabs, equipment and data centres; output lags spending. 购置厂房、设备与数据中心等长期资产的支出；产出滞后于开支。
Splitting a system into several smaller dies connected inside one package to improve yield, mix process nodes or reuse IP. 把一个系统拆成多个较小裸片并在封装内互连，用以提高良率、混合工艺或复用IP。
The group of US-arms-embargoed countries in the export regulations; controls can extend to companies headquartered there. 美国出口管理条例中受武器禁运的国家组；管制可延伸到总部设在这些国家的公司。
TSMC's family of 2.5D advanced-packaging technologies, commonly used to integrate GPUs or accelerators with HBM in one package. 台积电的2.5D先进封装技术系列，常用于把GPU/加速器与HBM集成在一个封装内。
Placing optical engines in the same package as a switch or compute chip to shorten electrical links; serviceability and reliability are common questions. 把光引擎放进与交换芯片或计算芯片同一封装内，以缩短电链路；可维修性与可靠性是常见的追问。

entries.t: CXL (Compute Express Link) / 计算快速链路
entries.x: Open interconnect with coherence and memory semantics, linking a host to accelerators, memory expanders and other devices. 具有一致性与内存语义的开放互连，用于主机与加速器、内存扩展器等设备之间的连接。
A programmable processor offloading networking, storage and security tasks from the host. 可编程的网络与基础设施卸载处理器，承担网络、存储与安全任务。

entries.t: DRAM / 动态随机存取存储器
entries.x: Main-memory technology that stores bits in capacitors and needs periodic refresh; DDR, LPDDR, GDDR and HBM are variants. 用电容保存数据、需要周期刷新的主内存技术；DDR、LPDDR、GDDR与HBM都是其变体。
Redundant bits added to memory or links so small errors can be detected and corrected. 在内存或链路中加入冗余位以检测并纠正少量错误。

entries.t: ECCN / 出口管制分类编号
entries.x: Export Control Classification Number in the US export rules, such as 3A090 for advanced-computing chips. 美国出口管制条例中对物项的分类编号，例如先进计算芯片适用的3A090。

entries.t: EMIB / EMIB（嵌入式多芯片互连桥）
entries.x: Intel's packaging technology that links adjacent dies through small silicon bridges embedded in the substrate. 英特尔的封装技术，用嵌入基板的小型硅桥连接相邻裸片。
BIS's list of restricted parties, to which exports generally require a licence. BIS列出的受限制对象清单，向其出口通常需要许可。

entries.t: FLOPS / TFLOPS / 浮点运算次数 / 每秒万亿次
entries.x: Floating-point operations per second; the peak depends on the number format and is not delivered task throughput. 每秒浮点运算次数；峰值值取决于数值格式，不等于实际任务吞吐。

entries.t: Foreign direct product rule / 外国直接产品规则
entries.x: A US export-control rule extending controls to products made abroad using US technology. 美国出口管制中把管制延伸到使用美国技术在境外生产的产品的规则。

entries.t: FPGA / 现场可编程门阵列
entries.x: A chip whose logic can be reconfigured after manufacture: flexible, but usually less efficient than fixed-function silicon. 可在制造后重新配置逻辑的芯片，灵活但通常效率低于固定功能芯片。
A massively parallel processor, now the main accelerator for AI training and inference. 高度并行的处理器，现为AI训练与推理的主要加速器。

entries.t: HBM (High Bandwidth Memory) / 高带宽内存
entries.x: DRAM dies stacked vertically and connected to the processor inside the same package through a very wide interface, giving high bandwidth at modest power. 多层DRAM裸片垂直堆叠，通过很宽的接口与处理器在同一封装内互连，以较低功耗提供很高带宽。
The annual symposium on high-performance chips; this site compiles patterns from its Q&A. 每年举行的高性能芯片研讨会，本站整理其年度问答模式。
Die-to-die bonding without solder bumps, joining copper pads and dielectric directly, giving finer pitch. 裸片间不用焊料凸点、直接铜对铜加介质键合的连接方式，可得到更细间距。

entries.t: Inference / Training / 推理 / 训练
entries.x: Training updates model parameters; inference uses a trained model to produce outputs; they stress memory, network and latency differently. 训练更新模型参数；推理使用已训练模型生成结果，两者对内存、网络与延迟的要求不同。

entries.t: IR analyst coverage list / IR分析师覆盖名单
entries.x: The list of analysts covering a company's stock, published on its investor-relations page; it is not full market coverage. 公司投资者关系页面公布的覆盖其股票的分析师名单；不等于完整的市场覆盖。
The contract between software and processor, such as x86, Arm or RISC-V. 软件与处理器之间的接口约定，如x86、Arm、RISC-V。

entries.t: Known-good die (KGD) / 已知良品裸片
entries.x: A die tested and judged good before packaging; a good die does not guarantee a good packaged product. 在封装前经过测试判定合格的裸片；裸片合格不等于封装后的产品合格。

Attention key/value tensors kept during LLM inference so earlier tokens need not be recomputed; it grows with context length and concurrency and is a source of memory capacity and bandwidth pressure. 大模型推理中保存已处理词元的注意力键/值张量，避免重复计算；随上下文长度与并发增长，常成为内存容量与带宽压力来源。
DDR memory aimed at mobile and energy-efficient designs: low power, moderate bandwidth. 面向移动与能效场景的DDR内存，功耗低、带宽中等。
Share of hardware peak FLOPs a training run actually achieves; high MFU does not imply cheap tokens. 训练实际达到的FLOPs占硬件峰值的比例；高MFU不等于低成本词元。
The machine-learning benchmark suite published by MLCommons; results compare only under its stated workloads and rules. MLCommons发布的机器学习基准套件；结果只在其规定的负载与规则下可比。
China's Ministry of Commerce, which issues export-licensing and trade-control notices. 中国商务部，负责出口许可与贸易管制公告。
The adapter connecting a server to the network; AI NICs often integrate RDMA and congestion control. 把服务器接入网络的适配器；AI网卡常集成RDMA与拥塞控制。
A processing unit aimed at neural-network inference, common in client and edge devices. 面向神经网络推理的处理单元，常见于终端与边缘设备。
Memory access time depends on where the memory sits relative to the processor; poor placement costs performance. 访问内存的时间取决于内存相对处理器的位置；放置不当会损失性能。
NVIDIA's high-bandwidth GPU interconnect; NVLink Fusion is its programme for partners building semi-custom systems. NVIDIA的高带宽GPU互连；NVLink Fusion是其面向合作伙伴的半定制方案。

entries.t: P99 / tail latency / P99 / 尾延迟
entries.x: Latency of the slowest 1% of requests; the tail can worsen even when the average improves. 最慢1%请求的延迟；平均延迟改善时尾延迟仍可能恶化。

entries.t: PAM4 / PAM4（四电平脉冲幅度调制）
entries.x: A signalling scheme carrying 2 bits per symbol to raise link rates, at the cost of greater noise sensitivity. 每个符号携带2比特的信号方式，用来提高链路速率，代价是对噪声更敏感。
The general high-speed I/O bus between host and accelerators, NICs and storage; the rate roughly doubles each generation. 主机与加速器、网卡、存储之间的通用高速I/O总线，每代速率翻倍。
Placing compute inside or next to memory arrays to cut data movement; the gain depends on host-side and ordering overheads falling as well. 把计算单元放在内存阵列内部或紧邻处，以减少数据搬运；收益取决于主机侧与顺序开销是否同步下降。
A scale-up domain of accelerators and switches; UALink 1.0 targets up to 1,024 accelerators per pod. 由加速器与交换机组成的一个纵向扩展域；UALink 1.0规范以单个Pod最多1,024个加速器为目标。
The three basic trade-offs in chip design; PPA alone, without the whole system, cannot settle cost. 芯片设计的三项基本取舍；脱离完整系统的PPA不足以判断成本。

entries.t: Prefill / Decode / 预填充 / 解码
entries.x: The two phases of LLM inference: prefill processes the whole prompt at once, decode generates token by token; their bottlenecks differ. 大模型推理的两个阶段：预填充一次处理整段输入，解码逐词元生成，二者瓶颈不同。

entries.t: Presumption of denial / case-by-case review / 推定拒绝 / 个案审查
entries.x: The default stance on licence applications: presumption of denial means refusal unless shown otherwise; case-by-case means individual assessment; neither is a general licence. 许可申请的默认审查立场：推定拒绝默认不批，个案审查则逐项评估，但都不是通用许可。

entries.t: RDMA / 远程直接内存访问
entries.x: A network card reading or writing remote memory without involving the remote CPU, cutting latency and CPU overhead. 网卡直接读写远端内存而不经过对方CPU，降低延迟与CPU开销。

entries.t: SAMR / 国家市场监督管理总局
entries.x: China's market regulator, responsible for antitrust review among other matters. 中国负责反垄断审查等事务的市场监管机构。

entries.t: SCA (strategic customer agreement) / 战略客户协议（SCA）
entries.x: Multi-year customer agreements Micron discusses in its earnings Q&A; per its 10-K they carry binding volume commitments, with most pricing subject to minimum and maximum bands. 美光在财报问答中使用的多年期客户协议；据其10-K，协议含具约束力的数量承诺，多数定价设有上下限价格带。
Scaling across nodes or racks over a network: lower bandwidth than in-node links but larger reach. 通过网络在多个节点或机架之间扩展，带宽低于机内互连但规模更大。
Linking many accelerators inside a node or rack into one high-bandwidth, low-latency domain that behaves like a single large machine. 在机内或机架内把大量加速器连成一个高带宽、低延迟的域，使其像一台大机器工作。
A provision of the US Trade Expansion Act of 1962 allowing import adjustments on national-security grounds. 美国《1962年贸易扩展法》条款，授权以国家安全为由调整进口。
A target for service quality such as latency or availability; options should be compared under the same SLO. 对延迟、可用性等服务质量设定的目标，比较方案时需要在同一SLO下进行。
One core running several hardware threads at once to raise utilisation, at the cost of interference and isolation questions. 一个核同时运行多个硬件线程以提高利用率，代价是线程间干扰与隔离问题。

entries.t: SRAM / 静态随机存取存储器
entries.x: Fast, area-hungry on-chip memory that needs no refresh; used for caches and on-chip buffers. 速度快、面积大、无需刷新的片上存储，常用作缓存和片上缓冲。
A contract term in which the buyer commits to a volume and pays even if it does not take delivery. 买方承诺购买约定数量，不取货也需付款的合同条款。
The sum of purchase, energy, facility and operating costs, comparable only once normalised per unit of service. 购置、能耗、设施与运维等全部成本之和，按每单位服务量折算后才可比较。
The design heat power a cooling system must carry continuously; it is not instantaneous peak electrical power. 散热系统需要持续带走的设计热功率，不等于瞬时峰值电功率。

entries.t: TPP (total processing performance) / 总处理性能
entries.x: The aggregate performance metric BIS uses to define which advanced-computing chips are controlled. BIS用于界定先进计算芯片受控范围的综合性能指标。
Google's purpose-built accelerator for neural-network workloads. Google为神经网络工作负载设计的专用加速器。
A vertical conductor through a silicon die that connects stacked dies, for example the layers of an HBM stack. 贯穿硅裸片的垂直导线，用来连接堆叠的裸片，例如HBM各层。
Open scale-up interconnect defined by the UALink Consortium for load/store communication between accelerators and switches. 由UALink联盟定义的开放纵向扩展互连，面向加速器与交换机之间的加载/存储通信。
Open chiplet interconnect standard defining the physical layer, protocols and management between dies in a package. 开放的芯粒互连标准，定义封装内裸片之间的物理层、协议与管理。
The Ultra Ethernet Consortium's Ethernet communication-stack specification for AI and HPC scale-out networks. 超以太网联盟的以太网通信栈规范，面向AI与HPC的横向扩展网络。
Umbrella term for accelerators other than CPUs, including custom ASICs; common in custom-silicon business language. 对CPU之外的加速器（含定制ASIC）的泛称，多见于定制芯片业务的表述。
